source.name: UCI Online Retail
source.attribution: Chen, D. (2015). Online Retail [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository.

measurement.timestamp_basis: naive source-local; timezone not asserted by source
measurement.basket_grain: invoice/distinct StockCode; repeated SKU rows sum Quantity
measurement.repeat_grain: identified customer within each separate window; observed gaps only
measurement.popularity_basis: positive sold units by SKU, not revenue or unique buyers
measurement.duplicate_policy: retain suspected identical eight-field rows; no receipt-line ID exists
